set_cover_position.name: Set cover position
set_cover_position.description: Moves one or more covers to the given position, respecting the automation lock. Lock OFF: moves immediately. Lock ON: writes to memory, applied on unlock.

open_cover.name: Open cover
open_cover.description: Opens one or more covers (position 100), respecting the automation lock. Lock OFF: opens immediately. Lock ON: writes 100 to memory.

close_cover.name: Close cover
close_cover.description: Closes one or more covers (position 0), respecting the automation lock. Lock OFF: closes immediately. Lock ON: writes 0 to memory.

apply_memory.name: Apply memory position
apply_memory.description: Forces the cover to move to its stored memory position, regardless of the lock state.

apply_mode.name: Apply mode
apply_mode.description: Moves the given covers to the position defined for the given mode. Returns the lists of applied and skipped covers as a response variable.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Name of the mode to apply (e.g. Night, Heat, Away…)

force.name: Force
force.description: Priority request: passes the inhibitions (a guest in the room), never the safety exclusions (an open window). Also re-applies the mode on covers already in it.

end_timed_mode.name: End timed mode
end_timed_mode.description: Ends the timed mode of the target covers now: each one goes back to the mode it was in before, as when the time is up.

compute_shade_position.name: Compute shade position
compute_shade_position.description: Computes the solar shade position for a cover based on its configuration and the current sun position. Returns position (0-100 %) and should_update.

get_mode_position.name: Get mode position
get_mode_position.description: Returns the configured position for a given mode on a specific cover.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Name of the mode to query.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads the cover configuration from the entry options without restarting Home Assistant.
